pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, predominantly polygonal patches with smooth edge gradients at the pixel level. Relative spatial area is variable, with larger patches visible on the central flank region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A topological network of light pelage forming clear junction nodes between patches. The pathways show high continuity with relatively uniform thickness across the mid-flank.
